_note: Map: repo grammar slug -> its recursive.eco grammar UUID. Same role as recursive-tarot's `tarot/_eco_ids.json` — `recursive-eco.json` points the channel importer at this file (`grammars.id_map`), and the static site builds per-grammar links from it: read = https://recursive.eco/view.html?id=<id> ; open in the app = https://flow.recursive.eco/g/<id>?view=reading ; fork/edit = https://flow.recursive.eco/create/dashboard/unified/new?id=<id>. UUIDs are stable across publish; a link only resolves for a visitor once that grammar is is_public=true on recursive.eco. Only PUBLIC grammars are listed here — the private ones are indexed, without contents, in grammars/PRIVATE.md.
